result.summary: Found several visual bugs: a broken delivery-fee value showing €NaN, a restaurant name truncated by the card edge, a cut-off category chip, and a second popular restaurant card cropped at the bottom.

issues.description: Smash Bros Burgers shows '€NaN delivery' instead of a valid price, indicating a failed number format or missing fee.
issues.suggestion: Guard against null/undefined delivery fees and format a fallback such as 'Free' or a numeric amount instead of NaN.

issues.description: The third 'Fastest near you' card title is clipped as 'Trattoria Piccol', so the restaurant name is unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Allow wrapping, ellipsis with full name on tap, or reduce type size so the full name fits the card.

issues.description: The last category chip is cut off at the right edge of the screen, so users cannot see or tap the full label.
issues.suggestion: Add horizontal padding or a fade/peek so the next chip is fully visible or clearly scrollable.

issues.description: The second Popular card (pizza, -20%) is cropped by the bottom tab bar, hiding title, rating, and delivery info.
issues.suggestion: Increase list bottom padding so the last card clears the tab bar when scrolling.
